name: Chikansha Thomas II
source:
Unable to control his lecherous ways, Touma Sujio was captured and deported back to Japan after committing a series of widely publicized sexual offenses. Set to serve time in prison, he was rescued by the world infamous Thomas: a molester so skilled, no woman could resist him after a mere single encounter. But for what ends, no one - not even Sujio himself - can say for sure.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070210175517/http://www.elizar.com/?p=41]old Nargrakhan review[/url]]
